values: Alper Ferudun, The Maximal Finite CP-Plus-Rank Equals the Maximal CP-Rank (13 October 2026), version1.0, AI-assisted unrefereed preprint; not Alec Kriebel authorship. Resolves Dickinson's separate Question(2), OWR-15957-003 (30003650): in every order n>=1 the maximal finite CP-plus-rank equals the maximal CP-rank p_n, including singular matrices and attainment. The same rank-preserving constructions directly give equality of maxima in each exact ordinary-rank stratum. The general maximum pointwise gap in Question(1) and an explicit numeric formula for all p_n remain unresolved. The positive Perron lift is credited to Bomze, Dickinson and Still. Existing DOI and all three published files verified; the closed18-member source archive contains complete proofs and exact rational regression checks, reproduced in three Python modes. These finite checks are supplementary, not minimal-factor certification or formal verification. No new publication or claim of chronological firstness. Source PR https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/pull/1156 ; existing publication https://zenodo.org/records/23350364 ; https://eulersolve.org/papers/owr-15957-003/ .

records.title: The Maximal Finite CP-Plus-Rank Equals the Maximal CP-Rank
records.description:
The cp-plus-rank of a symmetric matrix is the smallest number of columns in an entrywise strictly positive Gram factor. We prove that, in every order n, its largest finite value equals the maximal cp-rank p_n. The key observation is that a strictly positive factor remains strictly positive after a sufficiently small contraction along the Perron eigendirection. Combining this negative deformation with the positive Perron lift of Bomze, Dickinson and Still realizes every finite cp-plus-rank as an ordinary cp-rank in the same order and with the same ordinary matrix rank. The argument includes singular matrices and extends the corresponding interior two-sided Perron-ray identity. It determines the relation between the two maxima, not a numerical formula for p_n or the largest pointwise gap. The accompanying source archive contains a self-contained proof, audit notes and exact rational regression code. This preprint is self-audited and unrefereed; no absolute priority, independent review or formal-verification claim is made.

AI-assisted tools supported research, computation, proof development and manuscript preparation. The author is responsible for the final text. Corpus identifier: OWR-15957-003.
